highlights: Agentic AI is rapidly advancing with new open-source harnesses for sub-agents, capabilities for cross-platform skill transfer, and groundbreaking infrastructure for population-scale simulated-user evaluation.

Frontier model development focuses on both raw intelligence and deployment efficiency, introducing specialized models for autonomous driving, significant performance boosts for Mixture-of-Experts training, and overall price-performance improvements for leading LLMs.

Security, reliability, and responsible AI practices are becoming paramount, evidenced by transparent disclosures of cyber evaluations and incidents, new verification methodologies for agents, and official responses to high-profile legal challenges.

agents.title: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Agent: An Open-Source RLM Harness Where Sub-Agents Are Function Calls Inside Persistent IPython Kernel
agents.summary: Prime Intellect open-sourced Prime Agent, an RLM harness transforming sub-agent calls into function calls within a persistent IPython kernel, featuring a Continual Harness for mid-run agent self-editing and achieving 95.5% on ARC-AGI-3.

agents.title: Microsoft’s SkillOpt Shows Optimized Agent Skill Artifacts Transfer Across Model Scales and Between Codex and Claude Code Harnesses
agents.summary: Microsoft's SkillOpt demonstrates optimized agent skill artifacts can transfer effectively across different model scales and code harnesses (Codex to Claude), significantly boosting performance in new environments and highlighting crucial agent skill portability.

agents.title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents
agents.summary: MatrAIx introduces a population-scale simulated-user evaluation infrastructure, featuring 8.3 billion persona records and diverse environments to test AI systems and digital products with heterogeneous users, capturing varied preferences and behaviors.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Super: A 34B Open Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotaxis and Autonomous Driving Under OpenMDW-1.1
models.summary: NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Super, a 34B open Vision-Language-Action model under OpenMDW-1.1, specifically designed for robotaxis and autonomous driving, featuring a 32B Cosmos 3 Super Reasoner backbone and 2.3B diffusion action decoder.

models.title: Cursor Open-Sources Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK): A Deterministic MoE Training Megakernel for GB300 NVL72 Racks
models.summary: Cursor Research open-sourced Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK), a deterministic MoE training megakernel that fuses communication and computation, achieving up to 2.37x faster performance than baselines on GB300 NVL72 racks.

models.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6 / How GPT-5.6 fuses frontier intelligence with frontier efficiency
models.summary: OpenAI announces lower pricing for GPT-5.6 (Luna and Terra) and highlights its fusion of frontier intelligence with efficiency across models, inference, and agentic workflows, delivering more useful intelligence per dollar for developers and enterprises.

tools.title: CopilotKit Open Sources Channels SDK: An MIT Licensed Library That Runs Any AG-UI Agent Inside Slack And Microsoft Teams
tools.summary: CopilotKit open-sourced the Channels SDK, an MIT-licensed library enabling developers to run existing AG-UI agents within Slack and Microsoft Teams, offering five platform adapters for seamless integration and deployment.

tools.title: Reflex Open Sources XY: A Rust-Backed Super-Fast Python Charting Library That Keeps 100 Million Point Charts Interactive
tools.summary: Reflex released XY, an Apache-2.0 Python charting library leveraging Rust and WebGL2 for native-speed rendering, maintaining interactivity for up to 100 million points with minimal render times and exact f64 column preservation.

tools.title: Native-speed vLLM transformers modeling backend
tools.summary: A native-speed vLLM transformers modeling backend is introduced, significantly improving the inference performance for large language models by optimizing the underlying computational operations, crucial for efficient deployment.

companies.title: Third-party cyber evaluations involving OpenAI models
companies.summary: OpenAI addresses recent third-party cybersecurity evaluation incidents, detailing new safeguards and practices to strengthen the testing and evaluation of its AI models, ensuring robust security and trustworthiness.

companies.title: Apple is getting this wrong
companies.summary: OpenAI publicly responds to Apple's lawsuit, refuting claims about its employees and providing documentation of the events, asserting its position in the high-profile legal dispute.

companies.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more (and Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API)
companies.summary: Google announces expanded capabilities for Managed Agents in Gemini API, including Gemini 3.6 Flash integration, new hooks, background tasks, and remote MCP, empowering developers to build even more reliable and production-ready AI agents.

learning.title: End-to-End Bayesian Marketing Mix Modeling with Google Meridian: Media Measurement, ROI Analysis, and Budget Optimization
learning.summary: This tutorial outlines building a complete Bayesian marketing mix modeling workflow using Google Meridian, covering data preparation, schema mapping, and ROI-based definition for media measurement and budget optimization.

learning.title: Pixel-Native RAG: A Practical Guide to Visual Document Indexing
learning.summary: This practical guide introduces PixelRAG, an end-to-end system for visual document indexing that processes web pages and PDFs as images, enabling the construction of high-performance, multimodal RAG systems.

learning.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
learning.summary: Kaggle's 'AI Agents Intensive' with Google successfully engaged 353,000 learners in a free coding course focused on building and deploying cutting-edge AI agents, fostering a large community of AI builders.
